lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Henry Young is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Henry Young is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Henry kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Henry's gone." Wei looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Henry." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Thao blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Henry Young, 42 days. The mantle passes to Thao Ramirez.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Thao Ramirez, 34 — a comic shop owner. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Henry — and Henry is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: At the grave, Judith, Darnell, Priya and 2 more speak for Thao — "Henry trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Thao before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d101: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Malek blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d101: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d101: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Bilal Abbou, 101 days. The mantle passes to Malek El-Gharbawy.
d101: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Malek El-Gharbawy, 35 — a Baker. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach.
d101: You knew Bilal — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
d101: At the grave, Tiaki speaks for Malek — "Bilal trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d101: The fire knew Malek before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
